title: Setting an empty API key was not properly disabling access to the internal HTTP API, despite being… (CVE-2026-85567)
description: CVE-2026-85567 is a vulnerability where setting an empty API key failed to disable access to an internal HTTP API as intended. This flaw allowed attackers from IP addresses permitted by the webserver ACL to bypass authentication and gain read-only access to the API. The vulnerability has a low severity rating with a CVSS score of 3.1.
